messages:
carmen (Finance): FYI invoice INV-2026-0612 for BetaWorks (private) shows both 'Platform Fee' and an unexpected 'Migration Platform Surcharge'. Not in contract. Can someone check?

derek (Account Manager): We recorded a migration in Jan but contract addendum ADD-2026-BW says surcharge waived. Sending order notes.

oliver (Billing): Pulling invoice. Excerpt:
```
INV-2026-0612
Customer: BetaWorks (Private)
Period: 2026-06-01 to 2027-05-31
Lines:
 - Platform Fee (annual): $14,500
 - Migration Platform Surcharge: $6,000
 - Support - Enterprise (annual): $36,000
 - True-up usage: $3,240
Total: $59,740
```

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0612 generated at 2026-06-02T11:05Z by billing-service v3.5.0

carmen (Finance): GLs show surcharge mapped to 4015. If surcharge should be waived we need credit memo plus audit note. Also support line looks full Enterprise; customer switched to Standard on 2026-05-10 per ticket SUP-1033.

derek (Account Manager): Confirmed SUP-1033 and ADD-2026-BW waiver email from SalesOps. I'll attach both.

oliver (Billing): Flagging as billing system miss: support-sync job failed for BetaWorks during renewal window. Creating billing bug BILL-487.

pete (Legal): If we issue credit, ensure wording says 'billing error per addendum ADD-2026-BW' and include CM ref. Also check tax implications for reversing surcharge.

carmen (Finance): Approved to proceed with credit for surcharge and prorated support difference. Estimate credit: -$6,000 (surcharge) and -$27,000 (support proration) => ~ -$33,000. I'll create credit memo CM-2026-0608 and route to AR.

derek (Account Manager): I'll wait to notify customer until CM posts. Will prepare short note and include CM number + apology.

oliver (Billing): CM created and queued. AR ETA 2 business days. I'll link BILL-487 so engineering can triage.

carmen (Finance): Thanks. Action items: OLIVER -> post CM and update invoice records; DEREK -> customer comms after CM; PETE -> quick review for tax wording.

derek (Account Manager): On it.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-0608 created at 2026-06-03T09:12Z by billing-service v3.5.0
